findings.description: The KMS key does not have 'enable_key_rotation' set to true, which means AWS will not automatically rotate the encryption key material annually, increasing the risk from long-term key compromise.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No explicit 'policy' is defined for the KMS key, so it falls back to the default key policy which grants full access (kms:*) to the root account and effectively allows any IAM principal with IAM permissions to use or manage the key, weakening access control over sensitive audit data encryption.
